moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio s-molasses, written here): Target moves 0 → 1 on tension 280, friction 120, mass 1 (heavily over-damped, damping ratio 3.59): no overshoot, within 1 % by ~1940 ms. Kit form: springk(280, 120) over 1.94 s. Site rule: sticky like syrup, slow. Site demo: the target moves 102 px beside the response graph, with overshoot and settle readouts. Params: tension (280) · friction (120) · duration (1.94 s). react-spring's molasses (280 / 120): heavily over-damped, no overshoot, nearly 2 s to arrive.
